queries_run: Palantir customer concentration risk 2026 top customers credit downgrade OR bankruptcy OR guidance cut

findings.claim: FY2025 前三大客戶合計占營收 16%（FY2024 為 17%），前三大平均合作 10 年；曾有大客戶縮減支出或終止合約並需退還部分款項。
findings.excerpt: Our top three customers together accounted for 16% and 17% of our revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively. Our top three customers by revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025, have been with us for an average of ten years as of December 31, 2025.

findings.claim: FY2023–2025 無任何單一客戶占營收 10% 以上；應收帳款中 Customer I 占 25%（2024 年底 26%），無其他客戶超過 10%，應收總額 $1.0B。
findings.excerpt: Customer I represented 25% and 26% of total accounts receivable as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively, and no other customer represented more than 10% of total accounts receivable as of December 31, 2025 or 2024.

findings.claim: 2026-09-30 10-Q：Customer I 占應收帳款 27%（2025 年底 25%），應收總額約 $1.9B；搜尋未見信用評等調降、破產或下修財測事件。
findings.excerpt: The Company’s accounts receivable balances as of September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025 were $1.9 billion and $1.0 billion, respectively. Customer I represented 27% and 25% of total accounts receivable as of September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 僅下 1 次搜尋；未查到客戶信用惡化、評等調降、破產或下修財測的來源。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
